scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p desktop --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @monde/client && npm run build -w @monde/server
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w @monde/client && npm run desktop:compile
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run dist -w @monde/desktop --
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:content && npm run scenes && npm test && npm run verify:puzzles && npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && npm run smoke:server
